name: LOL: In Real Life
overview: Philippe Lacheau has invited Franck Dubosc, Clara Luciani, Redouane Bougheraba, Michou and Paola Locatelli to a bold new challenge: Playing LOL in the middle of an airport full of unsuspecting travelers. The rule is simple: Don't laugh... while also making as many of the people around you laugh as possible to rack up points. The winner will earn €100,000 for the charity of their choice.
